name: Ahmad bin Hassan
bio:
Ahmad bin Hassan's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Initially trained as a mechanical engineer, he found himself drawn to the precision and relentless problem-solving demanded by racing. After graduating from the University of Malaya, he took a position with a local engineering firm, quickly specializing in fluid dynamics and materials science. A chance encounter with a racing team owner at a technical conference led to his first foray into motorsport, working as a performance engineer for a small Malaysian outfit.

Over the years, Ahmad honed his expertise, working his way up the ranks to become a respected chief engineer. Known for his meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to performance, he demands excellence from his team. While some find his style challenging, his dedication to pushing boundaries and finding innovative solutions has consistently delivered results. Ahmad's understanding of vehicle dynamics and his ability to translate data into actionable improvements make him an invaluable asset to any racing team. He joined Brasil Racing five years ago and has overseen several successful seasons.

Ahmad is distinctive for his ability to identify subtle performance gains that others miss. He is a firm believer in continuous improvement and is always seeking new ways to optimize the car's setup and extract maximum performance. He also mentors young engineers and is keen to pass on his knowledge.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Ahmad is of average height, with a wiry build and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific type of Malaysian coffee before every race.
